name: m06_seed2_repro
purpose: TASKS 20: module 06's seed 2 has a training log from 26 September and a checkpoint from the re-run of 5 October in one folder, because the original checkpoint was never saved. This trains seed 2 once more by the registered protocol (m06/train.py, 20 epochs, the same dataset) into a dated folder of its own, so that one run's log, checkpoint and samples belong together and the module can say which numbers are reproducible. The 26 September numbers stay where they are; the reproduction is appended, as the rule of 28 September asks
command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=6 MKL_NUM_THREADS=6 python m06/train.py data/pubchem_aromatics_2026-09-24.csv notebook/out/seed2_repro_2026-11-14 --seed 2 --epochs 20

estimate.basis: the stored seed-2 log (notebook/out/seed2/train_log_seed2.json): 20 epochs of 1,614-1,857 s, 9.33 h in all, on six threads; seed 1 took 11.59 h. The 1,313 s of the first version of this spec is one epoch, not the run, and the 90-minute progress gap is three times the longest stored epoch

memory.basis: a 3 M-parameter decoder on CPU with batch 128; the notebook's own runs stayed inside the laptop's budget beside an 8-thread pyscf job
